notes: Only n_o was assigned; all other statistic fields and replication/success are unassigned placeholders. The assigned Experiment 2a is identifiable. Participants section reports seventeen couples (eight men and 26 women), while Results describes correct-response RT analysis and excluded error trials, but does not explicitly state the final analytic N or whether responses were aggregated within couples. The printed F(1, 16) does not establish N without inference from degrees of freedom. Recruitment counts therefore remain candidates only; no analytic N assigned. Recruitment arithmetic only: 8 men + 26 women = 34 recruited participants, in 17 couples; this is not an explicit final analytic-group sum and is not entered as analytic N. PDF pages 5–6 confirm canonical text layout.
